Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: hand-painted 2D game VFX animation sprite sheet, TRUE transparent RGBA.
Create ONE 4-column by 3-row sheet containing exactly 12 sequential frames of ONE powerful close-range fire sword slash. Every cell must share the same fixed center/pivot and same effect scale; keep generous transparent padding so frames never touch. No text/numbers/borders.
Reference images show ONLY the desired fire slash visual language. IGNORE the phone UI, social app, captions, characters, weapons and environment completely. Generate ONLY isolated flames, never a character.

A hot yellow luminous leading edge, rich vermilion and orange translucent rolling fire behind it, torn smoky-red wisps, jagged irregular lick tips and a few sharp tiny embers. The slash is wide and forceful but feels like real moving flames, NOT a rectangular yellow plate, neon C logo, rainbow ring, perfect circle, smooth orange tube, lightning outline, blade object, or repeated flame beads. Broadest at upper-left, thin red sweeping trail along lower side, upper end breaks into uneven flaming tongues that flow toward upper-right. Interior remains empty/transparent.
Animation timing and fixed framing: frame1 small ignition at lower-right, frame2 a lower sweeping thin orange arc, frame3 the moving front rises along left, frame4 rapidly growing large yellow crescent, frames5-6 broad strongest crescent with a narrow yellow-white edge and burning orange/red interior, frames7-8 the bright blade tears into uneven flaming tongues with translucent hot red wake, frames9-10 detached curling fire fragments along same footprint, frames11-12 only a few diminishing orange embers. Keep silhouette continuity, no random rotations, no scaling/camera changes. 2D painted anime tactical-game effects, crisp natural flame details and semitransparent edges. Compact controlled bloom only, preserve clear alpha. This will be sliced by exact equal grid cells and composited over an existing character; consistency matters more than a decorative illustration.
